fix: Drop .tint(.purple); use one high-contrast brand accent (emerald), saturation < 80%.
Replace Color(red::) with semantic system colors (.background, .primary/.secondary) so dark mode adapts.
Lead sections with .title2, content .body, metadata .caption; lead at least 4 steps above body.
Keep one containment idiom for one content layer; let secondary rows sit flat.
Restrict .glassEffect/.glassEffectGrouped in context; default to flat .background/.fill sheets.
Use real app chrome (toolbar + NavigationSplitView sidebar); distribute controls by task importance.
.borderedProminent for the primary action, .bordered for secondaries, .plain only in toolbars.
Add .help(Text(...)) on macOS and accessibilityLabel so icon-only actions are identifiable.
Use .redacted(reason: .placeholder) skeletons to reserve content shape; keep the spinner for short indeterminate waits.
Gate every non-essential animation on @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion); prefer opacity over translation.
